description: Four Latvian/English open-web batches searched general protest activity, national/municipal locations, health/labor and late-month episodes. Search coverage is not systematic LexisNexis/local archive coverage; no exhaustive claim.
required_followup: Independent reviewer may expand municipality, regional and week-window searches. No qualifying event established is not evidence no event occurred.

description: Searches surfaced commemorative/holiday processions and a health-sector labor dispute, but captured evidence did not establish a qualifying 50+ public gathering with a Latvian-state demand during November. A dispersed workforce/strike count is not a meeting count.
required_followup: If new leads are identified, establish actual event date, public gathering, simultaneous count and state target.

description: An NRA/LETA waste-incineration protest article discovered in this month’s search batch actually reports a 17 Dec gathering. It is recorded here as a lead only and assigned to December by event start date.
required_followup: Use the December event record for month-level coding; do not treat the 6,000 signatures as attendees.
